description: Test-only probe directory (no real endpoints) for `_check_aggregate_core_consistency`'s own regression test -- `router.json`-only, deliberately not endpoint-bearing, so it is invisible to the fixture client's own full-generation sweep (`endpoint_specs` globs `endpoint.json`, not `router.json`). Declares `default` so a hand-built leaf named `a` (no real directory of its own) resolves here via `_resolve_core`'s ancestor walk, while sibling `b/` overrides to a different core -- see `b/router.json`.
